mechanism: Ginseng may induce CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 enzymes, potentially reducing clobazam plasma concentrations and its active metabolite N-desmethylclobazam, which could decrease seizure control efficacy.
action: Monitor seizure control closely; consider clobazam dose adjustment or avoid ginseng use in patients requiring stable anticonvulsant levels; inform patients to discuss herbal supplements with their healthcare provider.
